title: Correcting your date of birth with Companies House
text:
It’s important that your date of birth registered with Companies House is correct. To complete identity verification requirements for Companies House, your details must be correct and match our records.

 You’ll need to submit a replacement for the original filing that contained the incorrect date of birth. How to do this depends on which filing was used to register the director or PSC with Companies House. You can check this in the company’s filing history on the Companies House register .

 After you’ve submitted a replacement, you’ll need to wait for the change to be processed before you can complete your identity verification requirements. If you’re authenticated to file online for the company, you can sign in to WebFiling and view the director or PSC’s details to see if their date of birth has been corrected.

 It may take up to 20 working days for a correction to be processed, as we’re currently experiencing high demand.

 To avoid delays, follow the guidance and submit your replacement filing online if possible. For example, to correct the date of birth for a director appointed after the company was registered.

 If the director was appointed before 1 October 2009 , you do not need to file a replacement document.

 If a director or PSC was added as part of company registration (IN01)

 You’ll need to complete and submit 2 paper forms.

 • The  ‘Replace a document not meeting requirements (RP01)’ form.

 • The section of the  ‘Application to register a company (IN01)’  form for the director or PSC whose date of birth needs to be corrected. If they are a director and PSC, you must include both sections of the form.

 You must also include proof of their correct date of birth, for example a photocopy of a driving licence or passport.

 Send all your documents together by post to:

2nd Filings Team
Companies House
Crown Way
Cardiff
CF14 3UZ

 For a director appointed after the company was registered

 If the director was appointed using the ‘Appoint a director (AP01)’ filing, submit your replacement filing online.

 • 
 Sign in to Companies House WebFiling . 

 • Select the ‘All forms’ tab. 

 • Select ‘Replace a previous filing that contained an error or had missing information’. 

 • Select ‘Replace a previously filed appointment of a director (AP01)’.

 It will take longer to process if you file paper documents by post.

 For a PSC added after the company was registered

 If the PSC was added to the Companies House register using the ‘Notice of an individual person with significant control (PSC01)’, submit your replacement filing online.

 • 
 Sign in to Companies House WebFiling . 

 • Select the ‘All forms’ tab. 

 • Select ‘Replace a previous filing that contained an error or had missing information’. 

 • Select ‘Replace a previously filed notice of individual person with significant control (PSC)’.

 It will take longer to process if you file paper documents by post.

 If the PSC was added as part of a confirmation statement (CS01) filing

 You’ll need to complete 2 paper forms.

 • The  ‘Replace a document not meeting requirements (RP01)’ form.

 • The ‘Notice of an individual person with significant control (PSC01)’ form.

 Send your documents together by post to:

2nd Filings Team
Companies House
Crown Way
Cardiff
CF14 3UZ

 If the director was appointed before 1 October 2009

 You’ll need to file the correct ‘change of particulars’ form. You do not need to file a replacement document or a form RP01.

 The ‘date of change of particulars’ must be 30 September 2009 or earlier. If the error was made on the original appointment filing, you should give the director’s appointment date.

 For companies in England, Wales, or Scotland

 Download and complete a 
 Form 288c - Change of particulars for a director or secretary ( PDF , 152 KB , 1 page ) .

 For companies in Northern Ireland

 Download and complete a 
 Form 296 - Notice of change of directors or secretaries or in their particulars ( PDF , 349 KB , 2 pages ) .

 For limited liability partnerships (LLPs) in England, Wales, or Scotland

 Download and complete a 
 Form LLP288c - Change of particulars for a LLP member ( PDF , 133 KB , 1 page ) .

 If the company is registered for protected online filing (PROOF)

 You must download and complete a 
 Consent form for paper filing (PR03) ( PDF , 220 KB , 2 pages ) and send this with your form.

 Protected online filing (PROOF) protects your company from unauthorised changes to its records. We’ll reject your filing if you do not include the PR03 consent form.

 To check if your company is registered for PROOF, sign in to WebFiling . The PROOF status is shown as a padlock icon on the overview screen.

 How to file your documents

 Send your form and PR03 by post to: 

Capital Team
Companies House
Crown Way
Cardiff
CF14 3UZ
changeNote: Form LLP288c added for limited liability partnership (LLP) members appointed before 1 October 2009.
